title: Record scoped conventions as advisory state with explicit conflicts
context: User, team, organization and repository preferences need reviewable records alongside Git-derived Project DNA without silently overriding repository rules. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Introduce nuryel.convention/1 as an advisory facet with explicit scope, sources, human review, source currentness and supersession. Flag differing values for the same key among authorized records instead of selecting a winner by scope hierarchy.
consequences: Human acceptance records review without granting policy authority.
Only authenticated humans can accept conventions; agents cannot overwrite or supersede human-confirmed records.
Conflicting preferences require resolution with the relevant people before application.
alternatives_rejected: Silently resolving conflicts through an organization/team/user hierarchy.
Allowing accepted conventions to override repository rules or replace Git-derived Project DNA.
